page.overview:
Who is Eadwulf Grieve?

Eadwulf Grieve is a human Volstrucker. He was a student of Trent Ikithon alongside Caleb Widogast and Astrid Becke. As an NPC, Eadwulf is played by Matthew Mercer.

In 819 PD, when he was approximately seventeen years old, Caleb recalled Eadwulf as having very short cropped black hair and blue eyes. He was taller than Caleb, muscular and strong, with thick black hair on his forearms and a serious look.

When they encountered each other in Trent Ikithon's laboratory at the Vergesson Sanatorium in 836 PD, Eadwulf had changed very little, being tall, wide-shouldered, with short black hair, wearing a dark piece of clothing covering most of his upper body and a stern look. He appears to be a follower of the Raven Queen, referring to her as "The Matron" and wearing a small silver pendant of a raven feather.

Eadwulf has maze-like black tattoos on his forearms and residuum crystals embedded within them, similar to those of Astrid and Owelia.
